## Core plugin

[**obsidian**](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/obsidian) is where Callout Studio lives: the source code, the releases, and the issue tracker. Other plugins can read your callout types through its [public API](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/obsidian/blob/master/docs/API.md), and the [contributing guide](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/obsidian/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) shows how to send a pull request.

## Web publishing

Published sites don't run Obsidian plugins. The plugin's **Publish to the web** panel (beta) brings your callouts along:

| Where you publish | What you need besides the plugin |
| :-- | :-- |
| **Quartz** 4 or 5 | [Callout Studio for Quartz](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/quartz) |
| **Digital Garden** | [Callout Studio for Digital Garden](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/digital-garden) |
| **Obsidian Publish** | Nothing else |
| A single note, with **Share Note** | Nothing else, and nothing to set up |

[How publishing works →](https://callout-studio.github.io/docs/16-publish-to-the-web)

## Documentation

| Website | What's inside | Built by |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| [**User guide**](https://callout-studio.github.io/docs/) | Every feature, for people who use the plugin | [docs](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/docs) |
| [**Internal docs**](https://callout-studio.github.io/internal-docs/) | How the plugin works inside, for developers | [internal-docs](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/internal-docs) |

Both sets of pages are written in the [plugin repository](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/obsidian/tree/master/docs). The two websites share one look and build, kept in [docs-theme](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/docs-theme).

## Project assets

README artwork, user guide illustrations, store screenshots, and icons are kept with the plugin, in [`assets/`](https://github.com/Callout-Studio/obsidian/tree/master/assets).
